errors.failedToLoad: The contract could not be loaded.

confirmRefused.title: Contract not confirmed
confirmRefused.missingAddress: This customer has no address on file. Add a current domicile address to the customer record before the contract can be confirmed.
confirmRefused.missingCustomer: The contract has no customer yet. Choose the buyer first.
confirmRefused.missingVehicle: This contract has no vehicle yet. Add one before the contract can be confirmed.
confirmRefused.missingPrice: This contract has no price yet. Add one before the contract can be confirmed.
confirmRefused.creditBlock: This customer has a credit block ({{reason}}). An offer is still possible; the contract needs the block cleared by accounting.
confirmRefused.doNotContact: This customer is marked do-not-contact. The contract cannot be confirmed.
confirmRefused.staleVersion: This contract changed since the page was loaded. It has been reloaded — review it and try again.
confirmRefused.badStatus: This contract can no longer be confirmed from its current status.
confirmRefused.generic: The contract could not be confirmed.
confirmRefused.tradeInValuationExpired: The trade-in valuation on this contract has expired, so the contract cannot be confirmed. Cancel it and create a new contract from an offer with a current valuation.
confirmRefused.vehicleLeftStock: This vehicle has already left stock (sold). It cannot be reserved again, so the contract cannot be confirmed.

editRefused.staleVersion: The contract was changed in the meantime. The current version is loaded – please make your change again.
editRefused.notPending: The contract is no longer open and can no longer be changed.
editRefused.generic: The change could not be saved.

cancelRefused.title: Contract not cancelled
cancelRefused.staleVersion: This contract changed since the page was loaded. It has been reloaded — review it and cancel again.
cancelRefused.generic: The contract could not be cancelled. Please try again.

actions.cancelDisabledReasonLegacy: Sale migrated from the legacy system — already invoiced there, so it cannot be cancelled.
actions.confirmDisabledReasonEmpty: Still missing a vehicle and a price.
actions.confirmDisabledReasonNoBuyer: Choose the buyer first: a contract is never confirmed without a customer.
actions.requestInvoiceDisabledNotConfirmed: Only possible once the contract is confirmed.
actions.requestInvoiceDisabledNotPurchased: The vehicle has not been purchased yet — the invoice can be requested once its purchase is booked in stock.
actions.requestInvoiceDisabledAlreadyRequested: The invoice was already requested on {{date}}.
actions.requestInvoiceDisabledLegacy: Sale migrated from the legacy system — already invoiced there.

requestInvoice.title: Request invoice
requestInvoice.hint: Which licence plate is the vehicle handed over with? It is recorded on the vehicle and can be found by search.
requestInvoice.requestedWithPlate: The invoice has been requested. {{plate}} is being recorded on the vehicle.
requestInvoice.error: The invoice could not be requested.
requestInvoice.moveBeforeStart: The plate is recorded on the other vehicle only from a day after this contract's delivery date, so it cannot be moved. Request the invoice without a plate and sort out the plate on Vehicle 360.

edit.title: Complete the contract
edit.hint: Until the contract is confirmed, its customer, vehicle, price build-up and trade-in can be added or adjusted here. Confirming freezes it.
edit.pricedWithoutInputs: This contract was priced before contracts kept their pricing inputs. It can be confirmed or cancelled as it stands, but no longer adjusted.
edit.pricedWithoutInputsNoBuyer: This contract was priced before contracts kept their pricing inputs. Its price can no longer be adjusted. Pick its buyer below, then it can be confirmed as it stands — or cancel it.
